credit: blackbearreloaded — independently authored normal-pad interoperability research
use: Reference for normal 120-byte read layout, standard button bit values, connected/intercepted handling, 64-record capacity and centered stick bytes. No proprietary binaries are included. ProsperoMenu's post-read entry, capture lease, event queue, relay and controller ownership logic are original implementations.
scope: Normal scePadRead/scePadReadState only; extended/device-specific read APIs require separate adapters. Static declarations and host execution do not establish compatibility on the supported console firmware.
